typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Claim_ID as string,
		Claim_Line as integer,
		Revenue_Code as string,
		Modifier_1 as string,
		Modifier_2 as string,
		Modifier_3 as string,
		Modifier_4 as string,
		Service_Date as string,
		Billed_Units as string,
		Line_Charge as string,
		Allowed_Amount as string,
		Member_Responsibility as string,
		Plan_Paid as string,
		Payment_Methodology as string,
		EAPG as string,
		EAPG_Version as string,
		EAPG_Weight as string,
		EAPG_Payment_Weight as string,
		Packaging_Flag as string,
		MSP_Flag as string,
		RAD_Flag as string,
		Bilateral_Discounting_Flag as string,
		Terminated_Procedure_Flag as string,
		Line_Item_Unassigned_Flag as string,
		PPD_Flag as string,
		SSP_Consolidation_Flag as string,
		CSP_Consolidation_Flag as string,
		APC as string,
		APC_Version as string,
		APC_Payment_Weight as string,
		Covered_Units as string,
		PROCEDURE_CODE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  DISTINCT [Claim_ID]       ,CAST([Claim_Line] AS INT) AS Claim_Line        ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Revenue_Code])) AS [Revenue_Code]      ,LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(PROCEDURE_CODE,1,5)))  AS PROCEDURE_CODE       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Modifier_1])) AS Modifier_1       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Modifier_2])) AS Modifier_2       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Modifier_3])) AS Modifier_3       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Modifier_4])) AS Modifier_4       ,LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),Service_Date,112) )) AS Service_Date       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Billed_Units])) AS Billed_Units       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Line_Charge])) AS Line_Charge       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Allowed_Amount])) AS [Allowed_Amount]       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Member_Responsibility])) AS [Member_Responsibility]       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Plan_Paid])) AS [Plan_Paid]       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Payment_Methodology])) AS [Payment_Methodology]       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([EAPG])) AS [EAPG]       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([EAPG_Version])) AS [EAPG_Version]       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([EAPG_Weight])) AS [EAPG_Weight]       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([EAPG_Payment_Weight])) AS [EAPG_Payment_Weight]       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Packaging_Flag])) AS Packaging_Flag       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([MSP_Flag])) AS MSP_Flag       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([RAD_Flag])) AS [RAD_Flag]       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Bilateral_Discounting_Flag])) AS Bilateral_Discounting_Flag       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Terminated_Procedure_Flag])) AS Terminated_Procedure_Flag       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Line_Item_Unassigned_Flag])) AS Line_Item_Unassigned_Flag       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([PPD_Flag])) AS PPD_Flag       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([SSP_Consolidation_Flag])) AS SSP_Consolidation_Flag       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([CSP_Consolidation_Flag])) AS CSP_Consolidation_Flag       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([APC])) AS [APC]       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([APC_Version])) AS [APC_Version]       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([APC_Payment_Weight])) AS [APC_Payment_Weight]       ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Covered_Units])) AS [Covered_Units] FROM [EXTRACT].[FL_3M_Outpatient_Claim_Line] ORDER BY [Claim_ID],CAST([Claim_Line] AS INT)',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceOutPatientLine
SourceOutPatientLine derive(Claim_ID = Claim_ID) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		Modifier_4 as string,
		Line_Item_Unassigned_Flag as string,
		SSP_Consolidation_Flag as string,
		EAPG_Weight as string,
		Modifier_1 as string,
		Modifier_2 as string,
		APC_Version as string,
		Modifier_3 as string,
		Terminated_Procedure_Flag as string,
		Claim_ID as string,
		Plan_Paid as decimal(0,0),
		PPD_Flag as string,
		EAPG_Version as string,
		Service_Date as string,
		Member_Responsibility as decimal(0,0),
		Allowed_Amount as decimal(0,0),
		Bilateral_Discounting_Flag as string,
		Revenue_Code as string,
		Claim_Line as string,
		Procedure_Code as string,
		APC_Payment_Weight as string,
		Packaging_Flag as string,
		CSP_Consolidation_Flag as string,
		RAD_Flag as string,
		Billed_Units as string,
		Payment_Methodology as string,
		Line_Charge as decimal(0,0),
		EAPG as string,
		APC as string,
		Covered_Units as integer,
		EAPG_Payment_Weight as string,
		MSP_Flag as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Modifier_4,
		Line_Item_Unassigned_Flag,
		SSP_Consolidation_Flag,
		EAPG_Weight,
		Modifier_1,
		Modifier_2,
		APC_Version,
		Modifier_3,
		Terminated_Procedure_Flag,
		Claim_ID,
		Plan_Paid,
		PPD_Flag,
		EAPG_Version,
		Service_Date,
		Member_Responsibility,
		Allowed_Amount,
		Bilateral_Discounting_Flag,
		Revenue_Code,
		Claim_Line,
		Procedure_Code = PROCEDURE_CODE,
		APC_Payment_Weight,
		Packaging_Flag,
		CSP_Consolidation_Flag,
		RAD_Flag,
		Billed_Units,
		Payment_Methodology,
		Line_Charge,
		EAPG,
		APC,
		Covered_Units,
		EAPG_Payment_Weight,
		MSP_Flag)) ~> TargetOutPatientLine
